description: This file defines the EducationDao class, which provides data access methods for the Education entity in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and counting Education records, as well as fetching lists with filtering and pagination support.

classes.name: EducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Education entity, providing methods to perform CRUD operations and queries with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Persists an Education entity and returns it.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingEducationIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing Education records matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Fetches a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for Education list with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education records matching filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Soft deletes Education records by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists.
